digest.component_or_area: agent-process metrics reader over event store
propositions: New read-only metric derivations over the durable event store must distinguish between metrics requiring per-event raw data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) and metrics satisfying on terminal compiled state (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery).

Raw-event metrics must reuse existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event, RETIRED_SUFFIX) for sorting, filtering, and retired-event inclusion; they must not reinvent file-listing or chronological ordering.

Compiled-state metrics must read terminal values from reduce_ticket(..., include_retired=True) and filter on specific fields: last_reopened_at absence for first_pass_rate; reverts[] with target_event_type in (STATUS, COMMITS) for revert_recovery.
Metrics over empty date ranges must return None (Unavailable), while populated ranges with zero qualifying events must return 0 (measured zero), establishing the semantic distinction.

Unit tests must validate per-event deduplication (two distinct sessions per ticket → attempts_per_ticket==2), time-window boundaries (3-day rework edge counts in 7-day window, 10-day does not), revert target-type filtering (STATUS/COMMITS reverts counted, COMMENT-only reverts excluded), and retired-event inclusion.
Registered metrics must declare source='structural' and confidence='high' in registry, reflecting authoritative provenance from the durable event store with no new emission.
